items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:6:1
items.html:
MA of Alephs: This is HaVaYaH with a filling of Alephs, thus: Yod-Vav-Dalet, Hey-Aleph, Vav-Aleph-Vav, Hey-Aleph. And the secret of the filling with Alephs indicates the correction of the breaking, for this new light, which issues from the coupling of AB and SAG, returns the AHP that were broken off from the degree back to their degree as at first. This matter is hinted at in the form of the Aleph [א], for in it there are two Yods with a Parsa between them: the upper Yod is Keter and Hochma, which remained in the degree, and it is the secret of the upper waters; and the lower Yod is the AHP, meaning Bina and ZON, which were broken off from the degree and went outside, and it is the secret of the lower waters. And the line that separates between them is the Parsa, the secret of the firmament that separates between the upper waters and the lower waters. Through the upper coupling of AB-SAG a new light issues and breaches this Parsa, and joins the AHP back to the degree.
And although the matter of the breaking of the AHP already occurred in the Partzuf Nekudot of SAG, as above, nevertheless the HaVaYaH of SAG is with a filling of Yudin and not with a filling of Alephs. Indeed, since the breaking was in the lower half of SAG, which are the Nekudot — for in the upper half there was no breaking at all, as above in the words of the ARI, that in the Taamim of SAG there was no breaking whatsoever — therefore its upper half, which is Yod, Hey, is with a filling of Yudin, whereas its lower half already has a filling with an Aleph in its Vav, and this Aleph hints at the breaking of the AHP that took place there. And know that this Aleph, which is in the filling of the Vav of SAG, is considered the root of the name MA of Alephs. And see above in the Table of Answers for the Explanation of the Words, Part 6, answer 1.

items.html: Taamim, Nekudot, Tagin and letters, which include the whole of Atzilut: The Taamim are Keter, and the Nekudot are Hochma, and the Tagin [crowns] are Bina, and the letters are ZON. The Taamim of MA, which are Keter, are Atik Yomin of Atzilut; and AA is the Hochma of MA; and AVI are the Bina of MA; and ZON are the ZAT of MA, which are called the letters.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:6:3
items.html:
Issues from the forehead of AK: That is to say, the raising of MAN was to the forehead, meaning to the Sefira of Keter of the Rosh, which is called Galgalta, since the forehead is there. And the reason for this is that the last phase of Nekudim is phase one, and therefore nothing remained in the screen except the aspect of the coarseness of Keter (as above, page 599, the passage beginning “It decreed,” study it there well).
And we must remember that there is no raising of MAN except to Bina, as above, and therefore the intention is not that the MAN rose to the Keter of Keter, but rather to the Bina of Keter. And indeed the Galgalta is considered only the Bina of Keter, as the ARI writes (in Etz Chaim, Gate 19, Chapter 8), see there. And understand with this that the Galgalta is divided in the likeness of Bina and in the likeness of Tifferet: its upper third is always covered and concealed in the posteriors of Bina, and only in the two lower thirds, which are the aspect of the ZAT of Bina and the aspect from the Chazeh downward of Tifferet, is the illumination of Hochma revealed, as written above (page 524, the passage beginning “Now”). And know that this is the secret of the anterior and the posterior of the Galgalta. For from the forehead upward is the aspect of the upper third of Tifferet, which is concealed and covered in the posteriors of Ima, and therefore the hairs of the Reisha [head] cover there. And the place from where the hairs of the Reisha cease and downward, as far as the Einayim — this place is called by the name forehead. It is the aspect of the two thirds of Tifferet that are revealed, from the Chazeh downward, for there the Yesod of Ima has already ceased. And this is what he says, “and the existence of this name MA of Alephs issues from the forehead of AK,” for there begins the existence of the revelation of the illumination of Hochma, as above. But above that place it is covered by the hairs of the Reisha, for it is the aspect of the GAR of Bina and the upper third of Tifferet, where the illumination of Hochma cannot be revealed. Understand this well.
